text:
Situation: Lactulose 10 g/15 mL 30 mL is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale General holds 222 eachs with 9.5 used per day (23.4 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 35 eachs with 1.8 used per day (19.1 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): The current label names Xttrium Laboratories, Inc. (FEI 3008436464) as the registered manufacturing plant. FDA inspected that plant on 2025-06-18 and classified it OAI, with the classification known on 2025-09-16. The most recent inspection ended 2026-06-16 and was classified VAI, known on 2026-08-24.

Our position: Supply is adequate at both sites for the near term. No shortage exists per FDA records. The ranked alternate manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place for quality assessment.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue current purchasing from Xttrium Laboratories, Inc. product (needs: buyer approval).
2. Qualify APOZEAL PHARMACEUTICALS INC. as first alternate source pending plant identification (needs: buyer and quality assurance approval).
3. Qualify Actavis Pharma, Inc. as second alternate source pending plant identification (needs: buyer and quality assurance approval).
4. Monitor FDA inspection outcomes for Xttrium Laboratories, Inc. monthly (needs: buyer approval).
5. Report days-on-hand weekly to P&T committee until both sites exceed 30 days (needs: pharmacy director approval).

Not recommended: Switching to alternate manufacturers before plant locations are verified and quality agreements are executed.
